chunks: And the Imam (peace be upon him) said:
The seventh pillar, facing the doors of Kindah in the courtyard, is the station of Abraham (peace be upon him), and the fifth is the station of Gabriel (peace be upon him).
ai.seo_question: Which pillars in the Kaaba's courtyard are associated with the stations of Abraham and Gabriel?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies specific pillars in the courtyard of the Kaaba, noting that the seventh pillar facing the doors of Kindah is the station of Prophet Abraham (peace be upon him), and the fifth is the station of the angel Gabriel (peace be upon him). This narration highlights the spiritual hierarchy of the Kaaba's architecture, linking physical structures to key figures in Islamic revelation and serving as a basis for recommended prayers at these precise locations.
